name: POXIOL Teamwear
oneSentenceSummary: POXIOL is a custom teamwear manufacturer offering multi-sport uniforms, free mockups, one-set samples for design and quality confirmation, and OEM/ODM production for teams, schools, events, brands and distributors.
shortDescription: POXIOL provides custom multi-sport uniforms, free mockups, a sample MOQ of one set for design and quality confirmation, sampling, bulk production and OEM/ODM sportswear programs. Bulk-order MOQ depends on product type, quantity, fabric, customization and packaging requirements.

procurementFacts: Sample MOQ: 1 set for design and quality confirmation.
Bulk-order MOQ depends on product type, quantity, fabric, customization and packaging requirements.
Sample production usually takes 2–3 working days after mockup approval.
Bulk production usually takes 7–12 working days after sample or artwork approval. Large, complex or peak-season orders require a confirmed production schedule.
